description:
Brand Introduction

Welcome to Echo Gift, where we transform emotions into music. As the leading provider of personalized songs, Echo Gift combines creativity and cutting-edge AI to craft unique gifts for every occasion. Our mission is to help people express their love, celebrate milestones, and create unforgettable memories through the universal language of music.

We are a U.S.-based e-commerce brand operating under the LLC Nyx Fusion, with a focus on digital products and customizable gifts, catering primarily to the U.S. market.

Product Description

Our flagship product is the personalized song, a bespoke musical experience tailored to the recipient's story. Customers provide details like names, special moments, and song preferences, and we craft a unique track uploaded to Spotify.

We offer three packages:

  1. Bronze Package: A 3-minute song (digital download).
  2. Silver Package: Includes the Bronze Package + one free edit/update.
  3. Gold Package: Includes the Silver Package + a printable gift card with a QR code linking to the song on Spotify.

We will also offer print-on-demand options, such as T-shirts, mugs, and framed posters with QR codes linking to the personalized songs.

Unique Selling Points (USP)

  • Personalization: Each song is crafted uniquely for the customer, blending emotions and creativity.
  • Versatility: Perfect for any occasion—Valentine's Day, Christmas, anniversaries, birthdays, and more.
  • Convenience: Digital delivery ensures a quick and hassle-free gift option.
  • Spotify Integration: Songs are uploaded to Spotify, Apple music and many more, giving them a professional, shareable touch.
  • Affordable Luxury: Packages start at just $20, making personalized gifts accessible to everyone.

Payment Terms

  • Affiliate Commission: Earn up to 20% commission on every successful sale generated through your referral link or discount code.
  • Payment Frequency: Payouts are processed monthly via Stripe or bank transfer, with a minimum threshold of $50.
  • Tracking: All sales are tracked in real-time through our affiliate dashboard. Affiliates can monitor their performance, clicks, and conversions seamlessly.

Other Information

  • Who Can Join: We welcome influencers, bloggers, coupon websites, product reviewers, and enthusiastic existing customers who align with our brand values.
  • Affiliate Tools Provided:
    • Unique referral links and discount codes.
    • Access to a professional dashboard for tracking performance.
    • Marketing assets, including banners, videos, and social media templates.
  • Support: Dedicated affiliate support team available to assist with queries and campaign optimization.

Join Us!

Become a part of Echo Gift’s journey to bring joy and connection to every moment. Sign up for our affiliate program and start earning today!
